author: More Perfect Union
description:
BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and other big financial firms are pushing a bill that would let banks invest your retirement savings in crypto.

The Clarity Act would merge the crypto economy with the real one, except crypto would barely be regulated. And it would enable the Trump family to keep raking in billions.

Producer/Host: @trevorp_hayes
Editors: @niklaak, @discosludge
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Crypto is coming for your 401k — and your bank is in on it
